sources.title: Energy Retrieval — Sun & Moon 116/149
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-06 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: 物品文字“Put up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.”：只能选基本能量卡。招式写法“Search your deck for up to N basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand.”（约 34 张）同样只认基本能量卡。

sources.title: Pokémon Trading Card Game Rules — Scarlet & Violet Rulebook（Energy cards; glossary: basic Energy card, Special Energy card）
sources.documentVersion: Official English rulebook PDF; text extracted and checked 2026-10-06
sources.supportsZh: 规则书把能量卡分为基本能量卡和特殊能量卡；“basic Energy card”不包括任何特殊能量卡。

dataContractZh: search_deck、search_discard_pile、discard 新增可选参数 basic_energy_only（true/false），为 true 时必须同时声明 card_category ENERGY，只有基本能量卡可选。
serverAuthorityZh: 服务器生成候选时按卡牌定义的基本能量标记筛选，提交时只接受服务器发出的候选；特殊能量即使在同一区域也不能被选中。
limitations: “基本 {R} 能量卡”这种同时限定属性的写法尚未接入（需要读取卡牌的基本能量属性）。
